title: The Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1970-07-30
source: MR(Abrams)>R@ 7.5 ips.(Peter Kafer)>R @ 7.5 ips.(Will Boswell) > CD; Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith 5/11; cd > flac dbpoweramp cd ripper

ai_review.summary: Thrilling Gospel‑era performance hampered by noticeable hiss from a multi‑generation soundboard transfer
ai_review.review: The set captures the Dead at a high point of their ‘Gospel’ period with an enjoyable short acoustic segment and soulful gospel numbers, earning strong praise from listeners. However, the sound quality suffers from a pronounced hiss that many reviewers say detracts from the experience, making the recording only fair despite the great performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers love the musical content but consistently note hiss and transfer noise; the show quality is high while the recording quality is only fair, leading to a solid but not outstanding overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High level of hiss and noise from multiple generations of transfer; cluttered sound that detracts from clarity despite being a soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short acoustic set followed by gospel‑styled numbers, with contributions from New Riders (Garcia and Mickey Hart) adding extra interest.
